# Pleasant Hill Summer Concerts

> Free outdoor concert series ("Sunset by the Lake") at Pleasant Hill City Hall, 100 Gregory Lane, Pleasant Hill, CA 94523. Produced by the Pleasant Hill Civic Action Commission. Concerts run every other Sunday, 6:00–8:00 PM, from late May through the end of August. Admission is always free and family-friendly; food trucks and beverage vendors are on-site, and most concerts include a pre-show Family Fun Zone with kids' activities.

## 2026 Season (May 24 – August 30, Sundays 6–8 PM)

- [Garageland Rodeo — May 24, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/garageland-rodeo-may-24-2026/): Season opener. Rock, blues & soul from Martinez, CA. Family Fun Zone.
- [AC & the Heatwave — June 7, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/ac-and-the-heatwave-june-7-2026/): Funk, soul & R&B covers. Family Fun Zone.
- [The Floorshakers — June 21, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/the-floorshakers-june-21-2026/): Funk/soul/rock dance band with horn section. Family Fun Zone.
- [The Bell Brothers Band — July 5, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/the-bell-brothers-band-july-5-2026/): Country, rock & Americana. Family Fun Zone.
- [Van Goat — July 19, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/van-goat-july-19-2026/): Oakland "swing punk" — swing, jazz, surf & punk. Family Fun Zone.
- [Zydeco Flames — August 2, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/zydeco-flames-august-2-2026/): Louisiana-style zydeco dance music. Family Fun Zone.
- [King Tritone — August 16, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/king-tritone-august-16-2026/): Rock covers from the '70s to today.
- [The Big Jangle — August 30, 2026](https://pleasanthillsummerconcerts.com/concerts/the-big-jangle-august-30-2026/): Season finale. Tom Petty & The Heartbreakers tribute.

## Key facts

- Admission: free, all ages, no tickets required
- Time: 6:00–8:00 PM (every other Sunday)
- Venue: lawn at Pleasant Hill City Hall, 100 Gregory Lane, Pleasant Hill, CA 94523
- Parking: free at City Hall and surrounding areas
- Bring: blankets, lawn chairs, picnics; food trucks on-site
- Organizer: Pleasant Hill Civic Action Commission, City of Pleasant Hill
